text: Nde Nulaaɓe maɓɓe ɓen ardirannooɓe waaju wootu ngun, gooto kala e maɓɓe, hiɓe yamira wiide, wata ɓe rewu dey, si wanaa Allah tun. Heeferɓe ɓen e maɓɓe wi'i: si Joomi amen haajuno jippinnde Malaa'ikaaɓe Nulaaɓe e amen, O waɗayno ɗum. Awa menen on, ko men yedduɓe ko nulaɗon fii mun kon, tawde ko on yimɓe honooɓe amen.
